name: QW Share Buttons
author: Himanshu Yadav

sections.description:
QW Share Buttons is a free, lightweight WordPress social share buttons plugin. Add WhatsApp, Facebook, X (Twitter), Telegram, LinkedIn, Pinterest and 25+ networks to your posts and pages — plus social media follow icons and optional Pinterest image share — without slowing your site.

Share counts are click-based on your site (not official network APIs), so they stay private, fast, and work with page cache and Cloudflare. Customize the design and placement, choose different networks for desktop and mobile, and review sharing activity in WordPress.

Fast and privacy-friendly

  • No jQuery on your site — the frontend script is plain JavaScript. If no other plugin needs jQuery, visitors do not download it (roughly 30 KB less).
  • Loads only where needed — CSS and JS load only on pages that show your buttons.
  • No cookies, no tracking scripts, no external requests — nothing is loaded from other websites when a page opens. Share links go to a network only when a visitor clicks them.
  • Visitor IP addresses are not stored — click counts are kept in your own database. A short-lived hashed key stops repeat clicks and expires in minutes.
  • Built with GDPR principles in mind — suggested wording for your privacy policy is added under Settings → Privacy → Policy Guide.

Why site owners install QW Share Buttons

  • Social share buttons for WhatsApp, Facebook, X, Telegram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads and more
  • WhatsApp click-to-chat — fixed button so visitors message you on WhatsApp (wa.me)
  • Social media icons / follow bar — link to your Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X and other profiles (shortcode, widget, or under the share bar)
  • Pinterest & image share on hover — visitors can pin or share images from your posts (optional)
  • Click-based share counts and a clear Share Statistics page (by network, device, and over time)
  • Floating share bar and sticky mobile bottom bar
  • Gutenberg block and Elementor widget — place buttons in the block editor or Elementor
  • Shortcodes, classic widgets, and a PHP template tag
  • Share on text selection — highlight a quote and share it
  • AI share buttons — ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Perplexity, Google AI, Muse (optional)
  • Custom Share Networks — add your own HTTPS sharing service with configurable colors and local icons; integrates with the existing share bar.
  • Style presets — Classic, Minimal, Dark, Pill, Outline and Gradient looks in one click
  • Desktop and mobile network visibility — set each sharing network to appear on desktop, mobile, or both
  • More Share menu — choose which networks go inside More manually, or automatically group extra buttons
  • After-Share Actions — optionally show a configurable follow or call-to-action panel after a share-button interaction
  • Weekly analytics overview — dashboard widget, Share Statistics summary, and optional weekly email digest
  • Customizable share container — control maximum width, alignment, background color, and borders for boxed layouts
  • BuddyPress and bbPress integration — optional sharing on eligible public activity updates, forum topics, and replies
  • Lightweight — CSS and JS load only when needed

Main features

Sharing
* WhatsApp click-to-chat — fixed wa.me button with your number and optional message (own WhatsApp Chat page with live preview)
* WooCommerce product positions — after title, price, short description, or Add to cart
* Inline share buttons — above, below, both, or after the first paragraph
* Floating side bar and mobile bottom bar
* Show after scroll — reveal floating/inline bars after 25%, 50%, or 75% of the page
* Native device Share button on supported mobile and desktop browsers (HTTPS required); configure its device visibility
* Copy link, Email, SMS, Print and 25+ networks
* Custom share messages per network ({title}, {url}, {site})
* Share preview card (title + featured image under the bar)
* Share on text selection popup (X, WhatsApp, Telegram, Copy)
* Image share on hover — one compact Share menu with Pinterest, WhatsApp, Facebook, X, Telegram, LinkedIn, Email, and Copy Link (off by default)
* More menu — manually select networks for the menu or automatically move extra networks inside it
* Optional UTM tags and WordPress short links on shared URLs
* Optional Google Analytics 4 / Tag Manager “share” event
* Optional After-Share Action panel with editable heading, message, and follow/CTA link
* Optional BuddyPress activity and bbPress topic/reply sharing

Follow / social media icons
* Profile links for Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Telegram, Pinterest, Threads
* Shortcode [qwshare_follow] and QW Follow Icons widget
* Own Follow Icons page with a plain-language guide, live preview, and size / shape / color options
* Optional display under the automatic share bar

Counts & statistics
* Click-based counts (not third-party APIs)
* Optional starting count (global or per post)
* Share Statistics — totals, clicks over time, by network, by device
* Top posts list with per-post Reset
* CSV export
* Weekly overview in Share Statistics, WordPress Dashboard widget, and optional weekly email digest
* “Shares” column on Posts / Pages lists

Placement & design
* Post types, categories, or specific posts
* Button shape, style, size, spacing, labels, colours, alignment — with live preview
* Per-network device visibility: desktop only, mobile only, or both
* Responsive container maximum width, optional background/border, and customizable background color
* Independent mobile alignment options for inline sharing
* Dark mode option
* Per-post controls: hide buttons, starting count, custom share text, reset counts
* Gutenberg block with live preview
* Elementor widget — networks, alignment, post/product ID, custom URL and title
* Shortcodes [qwshare_share_buttons] and [qwshare_share_count]
* Template tag qwshare_buttons() for themes
* Share Buttons widget and Popular Shares widget

Privacy & performance
* No official Facebook/X share-count APIs
* No background calls to social networks
* Frontend assets load only when buttons (or optional features) are shown
* Works with page cache and Cloudflare

Shortcodes

  • [qwshare_share_buttons] — share bar (optional networks, url, title, align, id)
  • [qwshare_share_count] — share count only
  • [qwshare_follow] — follow / profile icons (optional align)

Perfect for

Blogs, news sites, WooCommerce product pages, education sites, and any WordPress site that wants fast social share buttons, WhatsApp share, Pinterest image sharing, and social media follow icons without a heavy plugin.

External services

This plugin constructs share links that open third-party social network share dialogs when a visitor clicks a share button. No data is sent automatically by the plugin server-side; the browser navigates (or opens a new tab) to the chosen network’s share endpoint with the current page URL and title.

Services used (when the corresponding network is enabled):

  • WhatsApp (api.whatsapp.com) — opens WhatsApp share with pre-filled text. Terms: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service Privacy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy
  • Telegram (t.me) — opens Telegram share. Terms: https://telegram.org/tos Privacy: https://telegram.org/privacy
  • Facebook (facebook.com) — opens Facebook sharer. Terms: https://www.facebook.com/terms Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy
  • X / Twitter (x.com) — opens post composer. Terms: https://x.com/tos Privacy: https://x.com/privacy
  • LinkedIn (linkedin.com) — opens share-offsite. Terms: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/user-agreement Privacy: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/privacy-policy
  • ChatGPT (chatgpt.com) — AI button; opens ChatGPT with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/ Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
  • Claude (claude.ai) — AI button; opens Claude with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Grok (grok.com) — AI button; opens Grok with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service Privacy: https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Perplexity (perplexity.ai) — AI button; opens Perplexity with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/legal/terms-of-service Privacy: https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/legal/privacy-policy
  • Google AI Mode (google.com) — AI button; opens Google AI Mode with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Muse / Meta AI (meta.ai) — AI button; opens Meta AI (powered by Muse) with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://www.facebook.com/terms Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
    The AI buttons are ordinary links. Nothing is sent until a visitor clicks one, and then only the prompt text (which includes the page link) goes to that service.
  • Pinterest, Reddit, Bluesky, Threads, Nextdoor, and other networks listed in the plugin settings — each opens that network’s public share/intent URL with the page URL (and sometimes title). Consult each network’s own terms and privacy policy.

No personal data is transmitted by the plugin itself beyond what the visitor’s browser sends when following a normal share link. The plugin does not register with or call network APIs in the background.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload.
  2. Activate QW Share Buttons through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to QWShare in the admin menu to configure networks and display options.
sections.faq:
What does the WeChat button do?

WeChat has no public web share link, so the button copies the page link. Paste it into WeChat to share.

How do I show the share count somewhere else?

Use the shortcode [qwshare_share_count] (optionally with id="123"). It shows the same number as the share bar and updates after a share.

Are these official Facebook / X share counts?

No. Counts track share button clicks on your site only. They are not pulled from social network APIs.

What is the starting count?

An optional number you can set globally or per post. It is added to click counts when showing the total. It is not a claim of external network shares.

Can I set a different starting count per post?

Yes. Edit a post and use the QW Share box in the sidebar.

Can I write my own share message?

Yes. Go to QW Share > Share Messages. Use {title}, {url} and {site}, for example Read this: {title} {url}. Leave a box empty to keep the default wording. X and Telegram add the link by themselves, so leave {url} out for those two. Email has its own subject and body boxes.

What are the AI buttons?

ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Perplexity, Google AI and Muse (Meta AI) buttons. When a visitor clicks one, it opens that AI site with a ready question such as “Summarize this page: (link)”. Turn them on in QW Share > Select Buttons, and change the question in QW Share > Share Messages (AI Buttons Prompt). They are off until you pick them.

Why do the Claude and Muse buttons copy the question?

Claude and Muse (Meta AI) do not always accept a question typed into their link, so they can open with an empty box. When one of these buttons is clicked, the plugin also copies the question to the clipboard and shows a short message, so the visitor can paste it if the box is empty.

How do I move my settings to another site?

Go to QW Share > Advanced Options > Backup & Restore. Click Download Settings File on the first site. On the second site, choose that file under Import Settings and click the button. A wrong file is rejected and nothing changes. Selected categories and posts are specific to each site.

Where can I see which networks are used most?

Go to QW Share > Share Statistics. The Clicks by network list shows your top networks. The CSV export also has one column per network.

What are UTM tags and short links?

In QW Share > Counts & Tracking > Link Tracking. UTM tags add utm_source (the network), utm_medium and an optional campaign name to the shared link, so Google Analytics shows which network sent each visit. Only links to your own site are tagged. Short links share the short WordPress link (like yoursite.com/?p=123) instead of the long address. Both are off by default.

Can I track share clicks in Google Analytics?

Yes. Turn on Analytics Event in QW Share > Counts & Tracking. Each click sends a share event with method (the network), content_type and item_id (the post ID). It uses gtag if your site has it, otherwise the Tag Manager dataLayer. The plugin makes no requests of its own for this.

Can I hide the share buttons on one post?

Yes. Edit the post, open the QW Share box in the sidebar and tick Hide share buttons on this post. This turns off the automatic buttons (inline, floating and bottom bar) for that post only. A shortcode you add yourself still shows.

Can I change the text that gets shared for one post?

Yes. Type it in the Share text field of the QW Share box. It is used instead of the post title in shared messages, such as the X post text, the WhatsApp message and the email subject. Leave it empty to use the post title.

Does QW Share Buttons use jQuery?

Not on the front of your site. The share buttons, counts, More menu and text-selection popup all run on plain JavaScript. Your admin screens still use the jQuery that WordPress ships. If your theme or another plugin loads jQuery, that is not affected.

Is it privacy-friendly / GDPR-friendly?

The plugin sets no cookies, uses no browser storage, loads nothing from other websites, and does not store visitor IP addresses. Click counts are anonymous totals kept in your own database. This is not legal advice: if you turn on the Google Analytics event option, that tool’s own rules apply, and share links open the network your visitor chooses. Ready-made wording for your privacy policy is under Settings → Privacy → Policy Guide.

Can I choose different sharing networks on desktop and mobile?

Yes. Open QW Share > Select Buttons > Desktop & Mobile Network Visibility and choose Both, Desktop, or Mobile for each network. Existing selections are preserved until you change them.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes. You can set network visibility per device, choose mobile button alignment, use icon-only labels on small screens, and optionally enable a sticky mobile bottom bar.

What is the “Share” button?

It opens the device’s native share menu through the browser’s Web Share API where supported. It can appear on phones, tablets, and supported desktop browsers when configured under Desktop & Mobile Network Visibility. It requires HTTPS and browser support; unavailable browsers do not display it.

How do I configure the More Share menu?

Open QW Share > Select Buttons > More Share Button. Enable More, then choose Manual to select networks that appear inside the menu, or Automatic to keep a chosen number of buttons visible and group the rest. Disable More to return to the normal share buttons.

Can I remove the share container background or set a custom width?

Yes. Under QW Share > Button Appearance, you can set a responsive maximum width, adjust alignment, choose a background color, and disable the container background or border.

What are After-Share Actions?

Optional follow or call-to-action messages configured under QW Share > Share Messages. The panel can appear after interacting with a sharing link; opening a third-party share window does not confirm the visitor completed the share.

Where are the weekly analytics and email settings?

The main QW Share > Share Statistics page contains the analytics reports and weekly overview. A compact summary is also available as a WordPress Dashboard widget. Weekly email digests are optional and can be configured from Share Statistics; they reuse the plugin’s existing click-count data.

Does it support BuddyPress and bbPress?

Yes. Optional community sharing can be enabled under QW Share > Advanced Options for eligible public BuddyPress activity, bbPress topics, and replies. These features are disabled by default and require the relevant community plugin.

What is the mobile bottom bar?

A slim share bar fixed to the bottom of the screen on phones and small tablets. Turn it on under Settings > Mobile Bottom Bar. It uses the first networks from your Select Buttons list and can add the Share button.

Can I show different buttons in different places?

Yes. Add networks to the shortcode, for example [qwshare_share_buttons networks="whatsapp,telegram,copy"]. The buttons appear in the order you type them. You can use x for X (Twitter), fb for Facebook, wa for WhatsApp, tg for Telegram, mail for Email, link for Copy Link and share for the phone Share button. The full list of names is on the Shortcodes page in QW Share.

Can I share a link that is not the current post?

Yes. Use url, for example [qwshare_share_buttons url="https://example.com" title="Our new app"]. Clicks on a custom link are not added to the post’s share count.

How do I place buttons in a custom location?

Use the shortcode [qwshare_share_buttons] in content, widgets (if shortcodes are enabled), or a block that supports shortcodes.

How do I add share buttons in the block editor?

In the post or page editor, click Add block and search for QW Share Buttons. You can pick networks and alignment in the sidebar. The preview updates as you change options.

How do I turn on “Share on text selection”?

Go to QW Share → Advanced Options and enable Share on text selection. Save. When a visitor highlights text on a post or page, a small popup offers X, WhatsApp, Telegram and Copy. It is off until you enable it.

Where can I see clicks over the last 7 or 30 days?

Open QW Share → Share Statistics. Use the Last 7 days or Last 30 days buttons above the chart. Daily data is collected from version 1.2.9 onward.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. Frontend CSS and JavaScript load only when share buttons (or the text-selection feature) are actually shown. Counts work with page cache and Cloudflare.

  • Add optimized production stylesheets. [Load smaller CSS files while preserving all sharing features and editable stylesheet sources.]

  • Add per-network desktop and mobile visibility controls under Select Buttons. [Choose which social sharing networks appear on desktop, mobile, or both.]
  • Improve Network Visibility and More Share Button settings UI. [Added compact, collapsible panels with polished Customize buttons, improved alignment, and easier Manual/Automatic network selection.]

1.5.0

  • Improve responsive share alignment with centered custom-width containers and independent mobile alignment controls.

1.4.9

  • Add a WordPress dashboard share-analytics widget, weekly summary in Share Statistics, and optional weekly email digest.

1.4.8

  • Add customizable After-Share Actions and fix the follow/CTA panel for external sharing links.

1.4.7

  • Fix LinkedIn icons, button alignment, hover colors and Minimal style compatibility.
  • Add customizable share container width, background color and border controls.
  • Improve More button with network selection, display limits and a redesigned dropdown.
  • Improve Custom Network Builder validation, icons and settings handling.
  • Improve Elementor-friendly responsive layouts without new frontend dependencies.

1.4.6

  • Add optional BuddyPress public activity sharing and bbPress topic/reply sharing.
  • Reuse existing buttons and styles without new frontend dependencies; disabled by default.

1.4.5

  • Add Custom Share Network Builder with secure HTTPS URL templates, editable labels, colors, bundled icons and Media Library image icons.
  • Integrate custom networks with existing share buttons, ordering and click tracking without new frontend dependencies.

1.4.4

  • Add a single image Share button with a compact social sharing menu.
  • Add Pinterest, WhatsApp, Facebook, X, Telegram, LinkedIn, Email and Copy Link sharing.
  • Improve image-share compatibility, copy feedback and frontend cache busting.
  • Keep the feature lightweight with vanilla JavaScript and no external dependencies.

1.4.3

  • Fix: Style preset previews now show all three network icons fully inside each card, including the Pill preset.
  • Improve: Preset gallery sizing adapts to narrow WordPress admin screens without clipping the icons.
  • No changes to existing saved settings, frontend share buttons, or Click to Tweet behavior.

1.4.2

  • Add Gutenberg Click to Tweet quote-card block with quote, optional attribution, and a post-linked X share action.
  • Preserve existing share buttons and text-selection sharing behavior.

1.4.1

  • New: Style presets. On the Button Appearance page, pick a ready-made look in one click: Classic, Minimal, Dark, Pill, Outline or Gradient. Each card shows a small preview. A preset fills in shape, style, spacing, colors and the dark bar, and the live preview updates. Your labels and button size are not changed, and nothing is saved until you click Save Settings. The card of the look you are using is highlighted.
  • New: Gradient button style (also in the Button Style list): soft light-to-dark shading on top of your network colors or your custom color.
  • Improved: The Button Appearance preview now shows the Dark Mode Bar setting.
  • Fix: In the preset gallery, the Pill preview no longer sticks out of its card.

1.4.0

  • Improved: No jQuery on the front of your site. The frontend script was rewritten in plain JavaScript (share clicks, counts, More menu, share on text selection). The script no longer depends on jQuery, so pages where nothing else uses it skip that download. Behavior is unchanged.
  • New: Privacy policy text. Suggested wording for your privacy policy is now available under Settings → Privacy → Policy Guide.
  • New: Privacy & speed card on the Support page, with a button to the privacy policy text.
  • New: Privacy and speed details added to the readme description and FAQ.
  • Fix: The share count in the floating bar stays hidden as styled after a click, instead of appearing.

1.3.9

  • New: Follow icon styles. On Extras → Follow Icons choose the icon size (small, medium, large), shape (round, rounded square, square) and colors (each network’s brand color, or one color for all icons). The live preview updates as you choose. The shortcode also accepts size and shape, e.g. [qwshare_follow size=”large” shape=”square”]. Defaults match the old look, so existing sites do not change.

1.3.8

  • New: WhatsApp Chat page. The WhatsApp click-to-chat button now has its own menu item (QW Share → Extras → WhatsApp Chat) instead of sitting inside Advanced Options. The page explains what the button does in plain words, shows a live preview of the button on a sample page (it updates as you type your number, message and corner), and lists the setup steps.
  • New: Follow Icons page. Follow / Profile icons now have their own menu item (QW Share → Extras → Follow Icons) with a short explanation, where the icons can appear (shortcode, widget, under the share bar) and a live preview that shows each icon as soon as you type its profile link.
  • New: Editable text labels. Change the words on the WhatsApp button (for example “Chat with us” or “Ask a question”) and the text before the follow icons (for example “Follow us” or “Follow me”). Leave a box empty to show only icons. The shortcode also accepts label=”…”, e.g. [qwshare_follow label=”Follow me”].
  • Improved: The WhatsApp number box warns you when the number looks too short, instead of silently keeping the button hidden.
  • Fix: Description text under card titles touched the card border in the WhatsApp, Follow and WooCommerce settings. It now has the same side padding as the rest of the card.
  • Fix: The WhatsApp profile link in Follow icons could be typed but was never saved. It is now saved and shows in the follow bar.
  • Fix: The Shortcodes help page said follow icon links are set under Advanced Options. It now points to the Follow Icons page and shows the label option.
  • Fix: The YouTube follow icon was drawn with a damaged outline (lumpy corner). Replaced with a clean icon.

1.3.7

  • New: WhatsApp click-to-chat. Fixed floating button that opens a chat with your number via wa.me (Advanced Options). Optional pre-filled message and left/right position. Hidden on WooCommerce cart and checkout. Off by default.

1.3.6

1.3.1

1.3.0

  • New: Share preview card. Optional card under the share buttons showing the post title and featured image — similar to how the link may look when shared on WhatsApp, X or Facebook. Off by default (Advanced Options).

1.2.6

Your saved settings are not changed.

  • New: “Hide share buttons on this post” in the editor box. It turns off the automatic buttons (inline, floating and bottom bar) for that post. A shortcode you add yourself still shows.

  • Improved: The editor box is now called “QW Share” because it holds more than counts.
  • Improved: Posts that hide the buttons no longer load the share scripts and styles.
  • Improved: Deleting the plugin also removes the new per-post settings.

1.1.9

  • New: The share buttons shortcode now has options. Use networks to pick which buttons show (and their order), url to share any link, title to change the shared text, and align to place the buttons left, center or right.
  • New: Short names for networks in the shortcode, like x, fb, wa, tg, mail, link and share.
  • Improved: The Shortcodes page now lists every option with examples and all network names.
  • Improved: Smaller plugin download. Removed unused images and unused styles, and made the donation QR image lighter.
  • Fixed: A shortcode that shares a different link no longer stops the post’s own share bar from showing.

1.1.8

  • Fixed: Made-up or unknown network names can no longer be counted, so your database stays clean.
  • Fixed: The share shortcodes no longer show drafts or private posts to people who are not allowed to see them.
  • Fixed: A rare JavaScript error that could happen if the plugin’s settings did not load.
  • Fixed: Post titles with special characters (like &) now appear correctly in shared links.
  • Fixed: Email and SMS share clicks are now counted reliably, even when the page changes right away.
  • Fixed: Clicking a second share button quickly is no longer ignored.
  • Fixed: Very large counts now show as 1M instead of 1000K.
  • Fixed: “Reset all click counts” now removes only this plugin’s data.
  • Fixed: The share bar no longer shows twice when you add the shortcode to a post or when a theme loads the content twice.
  • Improved: The “QW Share Counts” box in the editor now shows on every post type that has buttons or counts.
  • Improved: The reset buttons now use a safer method.
  • Improved: CSV export now includes all your post types, adds a Post Type column, and works on very large sites.
  • Improved: Settings changes apply immediately.
  • Improved: Deleting the plugin on a multisite network now cleans up every site.

1.1.7

  • Added: New “Buttons in Mobile” settings page. Show on Mobile, Mobile Labels, the Mobile Bottom Bar and the Share button options are now together in one place. Your saved settings are unchanged.

1.1.6

  • Fixed: Share buttons now appear automatically (without a shortcode) on more themes and page builders, including block themes.
  • Added: Option to show the Share button on laptops and desktops too (off by default; works in browsers that support it).
  • Improved: Clearer help text under Where to Display, explaining how to select several post types and what each “Show on” option does.
  • Improved: The “Copied!” and thank-you messages are now announced to screen readers.
  • Maintenance: Simplified the copy-to-clipboard code (no change in behavior).
  • Added: FAQ entries for the WeChat button and the share-count shortcode.

1.1.5

  • Scripts and styles now load only on pages where buttons can actually appear (respects post types and Where to Display rules).
  • Fixed: “Count only on” post types can now be cleared completely.
  • Fixed: Email and SMS buttons no longer open an empty popup window.
  • Fixed: the [qwshare_share_count] shortcode now updates right after a share.
  • Share bar is no longer added when a theme or plugin builds an excerpt from the content.

1.1.4

  • Fixed WeChat button: it now copies the page link (WeChat has no public web share URL, so the old link did nothing).
  • Fixed Truth Social icon: the faded background shape now shows correctly instead of at full strength.
  • Allowed extra SVG attributes (opacity, fill-rule, clip-rule, transform) so icons render as intended.
  • Copy Link / WeChat: if the modern clipboard API is denied, fall back to the older copy method so the button still works.

1.1.3

  • Clearer settings labels: Select Buttons, Where to Display, Share Statistics, and Buttons On / Off.
  • Live preview on Button Appearance — see shape, style, size, spacing, labels, and colors before you save.
  • Preview matches the real buttons on your site (same look and brand colors).
  • Choose where buttons show: all selected post types, only some categories, or only specific posts/pages.
  • New Shortcodes page in the sidebar with simple examples.
  • Share buttons no longer appear in feeds, excerpts, or secondary loops.
  • Better accessibility: proper labels on buttons and safer link attributes.
  • Scripts and styles load only when buttons can actually show.
  • Safer cleanup when the plugin is deleted; better support for future updates.
  • Fixed a filter that could pass the wrong HTML for a single button.
  • Removed unused modal code.
  • Mobile visibility uses cache-friendly CSS instead of PHP device checks.
  • Social preview tip handles non-English titles correctly.

1.1.2

  • Fixed rare double-counting when two people shared the same post at the same time.
  • Only published posts are counted (drafts and private posts are ignored).
  • Added a per-IP rate limit so fake or rapid clicks cannot inflate share counts.
  • Shortcodes load their styles earlier so buttons do not flash unstyled.
  • Simpler, cleaner share-count tracking.

1.1.1

  • Share counts work correctly on cached pages (Cloudflare and page-cache plugins).
  • Shortcodes always load their CSS and JS, even on pages or widgets outside the normal settings.
  • Safer counting when many people click at once (no lost clicks).

1.1.0

  • Cleaner admin design: header, tabs, cards, network tiles, and sticky save bar.
  • Native mobile Share button (opens the phone share menu on supported browsers).
  • Optional sticky share bar at the bottom on mobile.
  • Better counting behind Cloudflare and other proxies (new Visitor IP Source setting).

1.0.0

  • First release of QW Share Buttons.
  • Inline share buttons and a floating side bar.
  • Click-based share counts, starting count, and per-post options.
  • 25+ networks, Copy Link, dark mode, and thank-you message.

  • Share statistics with CSV export.

short_description: Fast, privacy-friendly share buttons: no jQuery, no cookies. WhatsApp chat, follow icons, click counts, floating bar.
description:
QW Share Buttons is a free, lightweight WordPress social share buttons plugin. Add WhatsApp, Facebook, X (Twitter), Telegram, LinkedIn, Pinterest and 25+ networks to your posts and pages — plus social media follow icons and optional Pinterest image share — without slowing your site.

Share counts are click-based on your site (not official network APIs), so they stay private, fast, and work with page cache and Cloudflare. Customize the design and placement, choose different networks for desktop and mobile, and review sharing activity in WordPress.

Fast and privacy-friendly

  • No jQuery on your site — the frontend script is plain JavaScript. If no other plugin needs jQuery, visitors do not download it (roughly 30 KB less).
  • Loads only where needed — CSS and JS load only on pages that show your buttons.
  • No cookies, no tracking scripts, no external requests — nothing is loaded from other websites when a page opens. Share links go to a network only when a visitor clicks them.
  • Visitor IP addresses are not stored — click counts are kept in your own database. A short-lived hashed key stops repeat clicks and expires in minutes.
  • Built with GDPR principles in mind — suggested wording for your privacy policy is added under Settings → Privacy → Policy Guide.

Why site owners install QW Share Buttons

  • Social share buttons for WhatsApp, Facebook, X, Telegram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads and more
  • WhatsApp click-to-chat — fixed button so visitors message you on WhatsApp (wa.me)
  • Social media icons / follow bar — link to your Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X and other profiles (shortcode, widget, or under the share bar)
  • Pinterest & image share on hover — visitors can pin or share images from your posts (optional)
  • Click-based share counts and a clear Share Statistics page (by network, device, and over time)
  • Floating share bar and sticky mobile bottom bar
  • Gutenberg block and Elementor widget — place buttons in the block editor or Elementor
  • Shortcodes, classic widgets, and a PHP template tag
  • Share on text selection — highlight a quote and share it
  • AI share buttons — ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Perplexity, Google AI, Muse (optional)
  • Custom Share Networks — add your own HTTPS sharing service with configurable colors and local icons; integrates with the existing share bar.
  • Style presets — Classic, Minimal, Dark, Pill, Outline and Gradient looks in one click
  • Desktop and mobile network visibility — set each sharing network to appear on desktop, mobile, or both
  • More Share menu — choose which networks go inside More manually, or automatically group extra buttons
  • After-Share Actions — optionally show a configurable follow or call-to-action panel after a share-button interaction
  • Weekly analytics overview — dashboard widget, Share Statistics summary, and optional weekly email digest
  • Customizable share container — control maximum width, alignment, background color, and borders for boxed layouts
  • BuddyPress and bbPress integration — optional sharing on eligible public activity updates, forum topics, and replies
  • Lightweight — CSS and JS load only when needed

Main features

Sharing
* WhatsApp click-to-chat — fixed wa.me button with your number and optional message (own WhatsApp Chat page with live preview)
* WooCommerce product positions — after title, price, short description, or Add to cart
* Inline share buttons — above, below, both, or after the first paragraph
* Floating side bar and mobile bottom bar
* Show after scroll — reveal floating/inline bars after 25%, 50%, or 75% of the page
* Native device Share button on supported mobile and desktop browsers (HTTPS required); configure its device visibility
* Copy link, Email, SMS, Print and 25+ networks
* Custom share messages per network ({title}, {url}, {site})
* Share preview card (title + featured image under the bar)
* Share on text selection popup (X, WhatsApp, Telegram, Copy)
* Image share on hover — one compact Share menu with Pinterest, WhatsApp, Facebook, X, Telegram, LinkedIn, Email, and Copy Link (off by default)
* More menu — manually select networks for the menu or automatically move extra networks inside it
* Optional UTM tags and WordPress short links on shared URLs
* Optional Google Analytics 4 / Tag Manager “share” event
* Optional After-Share Action panel with editable heading, message, and follow/CTA link
* Optional BuddyPress activity and bbPress topic/reply sharing

Follow / social media icons
* Profile links for Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Telegram, Pinterest, Threads
* Shortcode [qwshare_follow] and QW Follow Icons widget
* Own Follow Icons page with a plain-language guide, live preview, and size / shape / color options
* Optional display under the automatic share bar

Counts & statistics
* Click-based counts (not third-party APIs)
* Optional starting count (global or per post)
* Share Statistics — totals, clicks over time, by network, by device
* Top posts list with per-post Reset
* CSV export
* Weekly overview in Share Statistics, WordPress Dashboard widget, and optional weekly email digest
* “Shares” column on Posts / Pages lists

Placement & design
* Post types, categories, or specific posts
* Button shape, style, size, spacing, labels, colours, alignment — with live preview
* Per-network device visibility: desktop only, mobile only, or both
* Responsive container maximum width, optional background/border, and customizable background color
* Independent mobile alignment options for inline sharing
* Dark mode option
* Per-post controls: hide buttons, starting count, custom share text, reset counts
* Gutenberg block with live preview
* Elementor widget — networks, alignment, post/product ID, custom URL and title
* Shortcodes [qwshare_share_buttons] and [qwshare_share_count]
* Template tag qwshare_buttons() for themes
* Share Buttons widget and Popular Shares widget

Privacy & performance
* No official Facebook/X share-count APIs
* No background calls to social networks
* Frontend assets load only when buttons (or optional features) are shown
* Works with page cache and Cloudflare

Shortcodes

  • [qwshare_share_buttons] — share bar (optional networks, url, title, align, id)
  • [qwshare_share_count] — share count only
  • [qwshare_follow] — follow / profile icons (optional align)

Perfect for

Blogs, news sites, WooCommerce product pages, education sites, and any WordPress site that wants fast social share buttons, WhatsApp share, Pinterest image sharing, and social media follow icons without a heavy plugin.

External services

This plugin constructs share links that open third-party social network share dialogs when a visitor clicks a share button. No data is sent automatically by the plugin server-side; the browser navigates (or opens a new tab) to the chosen network’s share endpoint with the current page URL and title.

Services used (when the corresponding network is enabled):

  • WhatsApp (api.whatsapp.com) — opens WhatsApp share with pre-filled text. Terms: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service Privacy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy
  • Telegram (t.me) — opens Telegram share. Terms: https://telegram.org/tos Privacy: https://telegram.org/privacy
  • Facebook (facebook.com) — opens Facebook sharer. Terms: https://www.facebook.com/terms Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy
  • X / Twitter (x.com) — opens post composer. Terms: https://x.com/tos Privacy: https://x.com/privacy
  • LinkedIn (linkedin.com) — opens share-offsite. Terms: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/user-agreement Privacy: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/privacy-policy
  • ChatGPT (chatgpt.com) — AI button; opens ChatGPT with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/ Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
  • Claude (claude.ai) — AI button; opens Claude with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Grok (grok.com) — AI button; opens Grok with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service Privacy: https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Perplexity (perplexity.ai) — AI button; opens Perplexity with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/legal/terms-of-service Privacy: https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/legal/privacy-policy
  • Google AI Mode (google.com) — AI button; opens Google AI Mode with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Muse / Meta AI (meta.ai) — AI button; opens Meta AI (powered by Muse) with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://www.facebook.com/terms Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
    The AI buttons are ordinary links. Nothing is sent until a visitor clicks one, and then only the prompt text (which includes the page link) goes to that service.
  • Pinterest, Reddit, Bluesky, Threads, Nextdoor, and other networks listed in the plugin settings — each opens that network’s public share/intent URL with the page URL (and sometimes title). Consult each network’s own terms and privacy policy.

No personal data is transmitted by the plugin itself beyond what the visitor’s browser sends when following a normal share link. The plugin does not register with or call network APIs in the background.

Custom Share Networks — create your own sharing buttons with HTTPS URL templates, colors, and optional image icons.
Where to Display — choose the button position, post types, and display conditions; configure WooCommerce product sharing.
Floating Share Bar — choose the floating bar position and scroll-triggered visibility settings.
Button Appearance — preview six style presets and customize button labels, shapes, sizes, and spacing.
Share Messages — customize sharing text for WhatsApp, X, Telegram, Bluesky, Threads, email, and other services.
Buttons in Mobile — preview mobile sharing and control mobile visibility, labels, and the optional bottom bar.
Counts & Tracking — configure click-based share counts, starting counts, visibility thresholds, and post types.
Gutenberg Post Controls — manage per-post share counts, custom share text, and automatic button visibility in the block editor.
Advanced Options — configure click throttling, text-selection sharing, image-hover sharing, and community integrations.
Gutenberg Share Block — insert QW Share Buttons directly into a post or page from the block inserter.
Text Selection Sharing — let readers share highlighted text through a compact floating share toolbar.

Elementor Integration — insert and preview QW Share Buttons in Elementor layouts.
WhatsApp Chat — configure a floating WhatsApp contact button with a live preview.
Follow Icons — add links to your social profiles and preview the follow buttons.

Shortcodes & Template Tags — see examples for sharing buttons, share counts, follow icons, and PHP integration.
